preregistration: docs/rep_preregistration.md (replication of v4 H1/H2 on MCL-WiC; draft, not frozen)
versions_note: WiC templates of the main evaluation unchanged; rep_wic_A (v3) = forced choice for A and (iv): no 'None of the above' option, asks for the closest meaning, number only. rep_hardneg_judge (v2) = the judge's instruction for the hard-negative candidates (Claude): `valid` (v1 wording, unchanged) and `meaning_changed` (added, decisions #18).

parse_definition.choice: Greedy output (up to 8 new tokens; WiC sense choice 4) equals exactly one candidate after lm.normalize (strip spaces, quotes and trailing punctuation; lowercase).
parse_definition.wic_generation: One non-empty line, not cut by the token limit, the original word form exactly once (case-insensitive whole word), not identical to the source sentence; [[ ]] markers are removed before counting.
parse_definition.nli_paraphrase: One non-empty line, not cut by the token limit, different from the source text.
parse_definition.nli_hardneg: One line whose word edit distance to the hypothesis is exactly 1.
parse_definition.atoms: At least one bullet line, not cut by the token limit; at most 8 atoms are kept.
parse_definition.wic_iii_step1: Both glosses '1: ...' and '2: ...' found (each truncated to 32 tokens).

check.note: Every evaluation item's paraphrase 1 (two sentences) is rated by two raters, mixed with 20 sentences of another item, up to 20 hard negatives (judge: valid = 1, the target word's sense changed) and up to 20 meaning controls (judge: valid = 0 and meaning_changed = 1, the sense did not change but the sentence meaning did), all judged BEFORE the sheets are built (first ones in the seeded candidate order). The attention check fails if a rater keeps more than max_kept_other of the other-item controls (3 or more of 20; decisions #21), or if BOTH raters keep at least ceil(0.35 x n) of the n hard negatives (7 of 20) or of the m meaning controls (the pair is the unit, as in the exclusion rule; decisions #17, #19); a part is not used if it has fewer than min_valid_hardneg / min_meaning rows. A rater who alone keeps at least ceil(0.35 x n) of a part is reported (lenient_raters) and does not change the decision (decisions #22). Each rater's kept counts on the first and second half of the sheet (by row number) are reported, descriptive only.
